tree.text: Repealed. Pub. L. 93–618, title VI, § 602(d), Jan. 3, 1975, 88 Stat. 2072.
The President may at any time terminate, in whole or in part, any proclamation made under this subchapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1975—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 93–618 struck out subsec. (a) which provided for termination of or withdrawal from trade agreements. See section 2135 of this title.
